verdict.rationale: iTerm2 ships a documented Python API (iterm2 package) that lets scripts create windows/tabs/panes, send text, run commands, and read session content programmatically, plus AppleScript support for launching sessions/profiles — this is exactly a documented control protocol for driving the terminal. Community corroboration confirms real-world use of the Python API for automation beyond AppleScript. Missing for 10: no first-party example specifically framed around AI agents driving the API, and no independent hands-on report of an agent using it end-to-end.
